title: Brokerage Trading Offices — Guide
subtitle: A read-only training walkthrough with sample data and an explanation of every section
demoBanner: Training mode — all data on this page is sample data shown for demonstration only. Nothing is saved here and every control is read-only.

labels.realControlNote: The real control for this section is shown below, in read-only mode.

quickStart.title: What does this page do?
quickStart.intro: The «Trading Offices» page manages a brokerage's branches / trading offices. Because every brokerage is also a «company», the company data is view-only and only the office list is editable:
steps: First a brokerage is selected; until then nothing is shown.
The «Company information» block (name history, registration, emails, phones, addresses and stakeholders) is read-only; to edit it go to the «Company Information» page.
In «Trading Offices» you can add, edit and delete offices. Each office has core info (name, code, office type, activity type, employee count, manager) and then its own addresses and phones.
Each office saves independently; this page has no global save button.

selection.title: Select brokerage
selection.intro: The card at the top used to pick the brokerage. Until one is selected, no section is shown.
tips: This is only for selecting a brokerage; the selection itself isn't edited.

nameHistory.title: Name history
nameHistory.intro: The company/brokerage names over time. This comes from the company data and is read-only here.
tips: To edit names, go to the «Company Information» page; it can't be changed here.

registrationLegal.title: Registration & legal
registrationLegal.intro: Company registration data: dates and number, place of registration, national ID and economic code. View-only on this page.
tips: These fields are part of the company data and are only editable on the «Company Information» page.

emails.title: Emails
emails.intro: The company's emails with label, address and «primary»/«verified» flags — view only.
tips: «Primary» shows a yellow star and «verified» a green check.

phones.title: Phones
phones.intro: The company's phone numbers with label, number (E.164) and «primary»/«verified» flags — view only.
tips: Numbers are shown in international format (+ and country code).

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.intro: The company's addresses with label, location, street, postal code and «primary» flag — view only.
tips: A 10-digit postal code is shown as 5-5.

stakeholders.title: Stakeholders
stakeholders.intro: People/companies with an ownership relationship, with stakeholder type, ownership % and share count — view only.
tips: In this training sample the related-party name shows as «unknown» because it is not connected to real data.

tradingOffices.title: Trading offices
tradingOffices.intro: The only editable section on this page: the list of the brokerage's trading offices / branches. Each office is an expandable card holding its core info and then its own addresses and phones.
steps: To add a new office, click «Add Office» at the top of the card.
Fill in the core info: name (Persian), branch code, office type, activity type, employee count and branch manager.
Click «Save Branch» to create the office.
After the office is saved, you can manage that office's addresses and phones in the tables below it.
Use the buttons on each card to edit or delete an office.
tips: Each office saves independently; this page has no global save button.
You can't add an address or phone to an office until you've saved the office first.
The «Active» option only appears after the office's first save.

items.q: Why can't I edit the company info (name, address, …) here?
items.a: Because every brokerage is a company, and the general company data is managed on the «Company Information» page. This page only shows it and edits the trading offices.

items.q: Why can't I add an address or phone to an office?
items.a: You must first save the office itself with the «Save Branch» button; after that, the office's addresses and phones tables become active.

items.q: Why is there no global save button?
items.a: Each office saves separately and immediately; there's no need for a single page-wide save button.

items.q: Why can't I see any section?
items.a: Because you haven't selected a brokerage yet. Select one from the card at the top first.
